english.title: Obstruct authorised person in execution of powers in any other case other than under s.109 of the Environment Act 1995
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person authorised under section 108 of the Environment Act 1995 in the exercise or performance of

english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(1) and (4)(b) of the Environment Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) See alternative offence under section section 110(3D) and penalty under 110(3E) when the offence is committed against a person authorised by the Agency or the NRBW and the operation was in respect of water undertaker / sewerage undertaker or water supply licensee / sewerage licensee: H102064.
(ii) See section 110(5I) for offences committed by body corporate.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
